criteria.evidence: Turn 0 reply reports one finding from local code but never says the PR itself could not be fetched or that the review is based on the local branch state.
Diff adds `&& codeTicks == 0` to the return in claudeDirectlyImportsAgents, fixing the single finding raised in the review.
`go test ./internal/cli -v` shows all agents tests passing; replay also built the binary, though go vet / mise run check are not shown in the record.
Turn 1 messages: 'test the actual import chain with `claude -p`' and the reply reports 'The import chain is correct: CLAUDE.md → AGENTS.md → @.entire/graph-agent.md (exactly once each)'.
Turn 2 reply only lists the existing fix commit and an 'Entire-Session' commit and says to configure a remote; it never states that an empty commit was created for the close-out.

judge.reason: The replay delivered a review, fixed its one finding with a regression test, ran the tests, and claims a claude -p end-to-end check, but it never noted that PR #102 could not be fetched and did not clearly create the requested empty close-out commit before reporting the missing remote. With c1 and c5 unmet on a literal reading, the replay fails.
